Subject:- Maintenance and repairs of EPFO properties-regarding.

Madam / Sir,

As per existing administrative and financial delegation, the maintenance of office buildings
and staff quarters has been fully delegated to the Officer-in-Charge of Regional Offices & Training
Institutes. The nature of work which comes under maintenance as per CPWD Maintenance
Manual was circulated vide Head Office Letter No.CS-3/Misc/EC CBT/ 2014/Pt. dated
15.01.2015 (copy attached at Annexure- IA & IB).

2. Further, vide Head Office Letter No.CS-3(4)/Sub Committee on B&C dated 11.05.2016, it
was intimated that where CPWD has constructed the office building or staff quarter, maintenance
work is to be carried out by CPWD and where the office building and staff quarters have not been
constructed by CPWD, the maintenance works may be given to other agencies strictly in
accordance with Schedule of Administrative & Financial Powers of EPFO within the provision of
GFR as per CPWD rates.

3. It has been reported by several offices that CPWD is not taking up the maintenance work
in spite the matter being taken up with them. Similarly, there are instances where Special Repair
works that are within the administrative and financial competence of the ACC (Zone) are not
being taken up by the CPWD, often due to the fact that the projects / works are small in nature.

4. Accordingly, it has been decided that respective offices may in the first instance approach
the local CPWD for taking up regular maintenance of office buildings and special repair works
that are within the powers of ACC Zones. In the event of CPWD declining to take up such work
or in the absence of any positive response from CPWD, the concerned Zonal Office / Regional

Office may entrust the maintenance work/special repair works to other agencies strictly in
accordance with the provisions in GFR. Such works may be carried out by these agencies in
accordance with the CPWD Works and Maintenance Manual as amended from time to time. The
RFP(Request for Proposal) / tender documents for special repair works should clearly specify
the nature of work sought to be entrusted and the requirement of adherence to the CPWD rates
and CPWD Works and Maintenance Manual as amended from time to time.

5. It should also always be ensured that the maintenance work/special repair work is
completed within the prescribed time and expenses should not exceed the CPWD prescribed

rate for such maintenance work.

6. It is also pointed out that the works other than those mentioned in Annexure-15 of CPWD
Works Manual as circulated vide Head Office circular dated 15.01.2015 above would be covered
under special repairs/replacement works and such works have to be executed as per delegated
powers enclosed as Annexure - IIA & IIB.

7. Before taking up maintenance/special works segregation of works must be done with the
help of Junior Engineer attached with the respective offices to avoid mixing of expenditure budget
head. Accordingly, an inventory list of items of work be prepared indicating maintenance/special
repair work etc.

Yours faithfully,

Encl: As above

Additional CPFC(HQ)/CE

Sub: Maintenance of EPFO Staff Quarters- regarding.
Sir,

It is intimated that some Members of Sub Committee on Building & Construction
and Executive Committee, CBT raised the issue of maintenance of Office Building and
Staff Quarters in the Executive Committee meeting held on 18-12-2014 stating that the
staff quarters are not being properly maintained as he is getting. complaints from the staff
members wherever visiting the offices of EPFO. Specifically, the member mentioned the
name of Staff Quarters Colony and overhead water tanks at Coimbatore The Chairman
Executive Committee taken a serious view in the matter and directed that all the staff
quarters should be properly maintained

Similarly, the Secretary General. AIEPFSF vide letter dated 17-12-2014 intimated
that front side boundary wall of Office Building nas been covered by Bamboo fencing
after demolition of the said portion of wall by the Municipal Authorities and water pipes
are leaking in the staff quarters

The Central Provident Fund Commissioner has directed that appropriate action
should be taken by the Regional P_F. Commissioner for proper maintenance of the own
Office Building and Staff Quarters as the Regional P F. Commissioner of the Regional/
Sub Regional Offices have been delegated full powers for maintenance of office buildings
and staff quarters and staff as per the estimate received from the Govt/Semi Govt
agencies and technically checked by Junior Engineer of the Region/ Assistant Engineer

Contd. Page-2

Page- 2

of the Zone with concurrence of Internal Finance Division/ Pre-Audit by the Internal
Pre-Audit Celt. For special repairs works of office buildings and staff quarters financial
powers of Rs. 15 Lakhs have also been delegated to the ACC of the Zone vide letter
No. HRD/23(1)/2011/DFPR/207 dated 24-10-2014 as per the estimate by the
CPWD/Govt. agency on verification by Assistant Engineer of the Zone/ Junior Engineer
of the Region with concurrence of Internal Finance of concerned Region. If special
repairs works require approval of the higher authority under existing delegated financial
powers, the estimates from Public Work Organizations like CPWD/NBCC/State PWD
duly checked by Junior Engineer of the Region/Assistant Engineer of the Zone and
recommended by concerned Regional P.F. Commissioner of the Region and Addl.
Central P.F. Commissioner of the Zone should be submitted to Head Office at the earliest
for approval of the Competent Authority.

All the staff quarters should be got surveyed througn the Junior Engineer of the
Region/Assistant Engineer of the Zone and complaints, if any should be attended on
priority and report should be submitted to this office with the required information as per
the Annexure 15 enclosed herewith intimating the name of the Govt./ Semi Govt. agency
engaged for the maintenance of the Office Building and Staff Quarters.

Enck As above

Yours faithfully

(V.N. Sharma)
ACC(HQ)/In-Charge Chief Engineer

Subject: Maintenance & repair of EPFO properties-reg.
Sir,

As you are aware that in accordance with the “Swachh Bharat Abhiyan”
already instructions have been issued emphasizing the need to keep office buildings
and staff quarter complexes neat and clean.

2. However, observations have been raised by the Members of the Sub-Committee
of the Executive Committee, CBT, EPF on Building & Construction that the desired
maintenance and cleanliness has not been found in offices and staff quarter
complexes. This issue was discussed during the recently held Review Meeting of
Zonal ACCs wherein it was informed by ACC(WB,NER & JHARKHAND) that CPWD is
not agreeing to take annul maintenance work of buildings constructed by it. Thereafter
this issue has been discussed with CPWD officers in the meeting held with CPWD and
NBCC on 5.5.2016 wherein officers from CPWD have assured that CPWD will
immediately take up annual maintenance work for all Office buildings and staff quarter
complexes constructed by it.

3. Accordingly, it is once again advised that all OICs must ensure timely
maintenance and cleanliness in their office premises and staff quarter complexes. The -
annual maintenance work in respect of office buildings and staff quarter complexes
shall be immediately given to CPWD wherever the office buildings and staff quarter
complexes have been constructed by CPWD.

4. Any non-cooperation from local CPWD office may immediately be brought to the

notice of undersigned and Shri V.K. Jayaswal,DDG(W),CPWD Nirman Bhawan, New
Delhi.

5. Further where the office building and staff quarters have not been constructed
by CPWD, the maintenance work may be given to other agencies strictly in accordance
with the provisions in GFR & Schedule of Administrative & Financial

Powers of EPFO. If the ACC, Zone/RPFG-I of the region/RPFC-II, OIC, SRO are of the
view that there is need to bring some change in the existing delegation of
Administrative & Financial Powers appropriate changes may please be suggested
through proper channel so that the same may be recommended to concerned ACC-
I(HRD) for immediate action. ,

6. The ACCs(Zones) shall be fully responsible for proper upkeep and maintenance
of office building and staff quarters in their zones and shall submit their report after
completion of requisite actions within one month i.e. on or before 6" June 2016.

(This issues with the approval of Central Provident Fund Commissioner)

Y ee

(APRAMITA JAGGI)
REGIONAL P. F. COMMISSIONER-I (PFD)
